documents.title: Team chat
documents.text:
Priya: Is the projector in room 4 working?
Luis: No, the bulb burned out this morning.
Priya: Then let's move the presentation to room 2.
Luis: Good idea. I'll tell the others now.

questions.prompt: What problem do the speakers discuss?
questions.explanation: Luis says the bulb burned out, so the projector does not work.
Priya suggests moving the presentation to room 2.

documents.text: Book a weekend at the Lakeside Hotel and enjoy 20% off. Offer valid for stays until June 30. Breakfast is included.

documents.title: Booking confirmation
documents.text:
Dear Mr. Evans,
Your reservation for June 14-15 is confirmed. The discount has been applied. A parking space is available for an additional $10 per night.
Lakeside Hotel
